patch_description: Correlation (0.96) and efficiency (1.00) are saturated; the only remaining headroom is in smoothness (0.23), false reversals (49.2), and slope changes (66). Adding a light unconditional third zero-phase SG pass after the slope-lead compensation suppresses residual output ripple introduced by the lead step. Using a small half-window `h = max(2, sg_half//3)` with order-2 coefficients keeps lag cost negligible (zero-phase, tiny kernel), while flattening micro-oscillations that drive false reversals and smoothness penalties. The existing `_sg_smooth` helper already handles reflect-padding and degenerate-length fallbacks, so it can be reused verbatim.
